blocks.value: This is the longest lesson in the tier, and the one that makes object-oriented programming worth the trouble.

Inheritance lets you write shared behavior once. Polymorphism lets you write code that works on a `Person` and automatically does the right thing for every kind of person that will ever exist, including kinds invented after your code was written. That is a different kind of leverage from anything in the beginner tier.
What you will be able to do
By the end of this lesson you will be able to:

items: Choose between an interface and an abstract class
